summary: frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh's GitHub release archive, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the shipped 727KB `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW`), hex-mangled identifiers, and a ~10000-entry char-code/string lookup table (`n7gIxM`), and is emitted as a Bun-specific cjs bundle with no source map. The package's declared purpose is a CircleCI-orb aggregator (YAML in src/), which has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque native-JS blob. The declared `main: index.js` entry point is absent from the tarball, so the package is not usable as a library — its only effect on installation is the dropper chain that pulls in Bun and runs the obfuscated payload with it. Pulling an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle is a known evasion pattern that bypasses Node-based scanners; the payload cannot be statically vetted before it runs on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
